newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Plastics jumps on IC card hopes.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Plastics jumps on IC card hopes.

text.p: Mitsubishi Plastics Industries Ltd jumped on Tuesday morning as investors bought the firm's shares on hopes that it would benefit from the use of integrated circuit (IC) cards for public telephones, brokers said.
As of 0102 GMT, the shares were up 57 yen at 477 and were the sixth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with trade totalling 1.59 million shares.
NTT has said it will soon begin converting its public phones, which currently total 794,000, into phones that use IC cards.
